A FEW GOOD QUESTIONS

Before you
make the call.

Do I need an account or an internet connection?+

No account is required for Free Local. Open, edit, organize, inspect history, and test reachable local APIs without API Workbench services. Requests to internet endpoints require a network connection.

Where does my data live?+

On Windows, local data lives in %LOCALAPPDATA%\ApiCollabPlatform. Sensitive saved fields are protected with Windows user-scoped encryption. Use the app’s password-encrypted portable backup to move work between computers or Windows accounts.

How do I install, update, or uninstall?+

Run either installer and choose your folder. Open API Workbench from the Start menu. Close the app before updating or switching editions. Both editions share one installation; uninstalling removes program files and shortcuts while preserving your local workspaces.

What is included in the CLI bundle?+

The desktop app plus apicollab.exe. Open API Workbench CLI from the Start menu, or run it from its installation folder. It lists local collection IDs and runs saved collections with environments, retries, delays, and stop-on-failure.

Are Personal Sync and Collaboration available?+

They are marked Coming soon. This beta focuses on Free Local. Cloud sync and shared team workspaces are unavailable in this release.

What should I know about this beta?+

The installers are unsigned beta builds for evaluation. Existing dependency security advisories are documented in the bundled beta notes. Back up important local work before testing updates. The installers ship with no saved workspaces, credentials, or test history.
